sources.snippet: Alibaba's Qwen team dropped Qwen 3.5 on February 16, 2026, and it immediately shook up the AI landscape. Built on a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, the flagship Qwen3.5-397B-A17B packs 397 billion total parameters while activating only 17 billion per forward pass - delivering frontier-level intelligence at a fraction of the compute cost. sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B - 262k context, multimodal, open source
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is an open-source model in the Qwen3.5 family. The structured metadata tracks a 262k-token context window, multimodal input, function calling, tool use, and structured outputs.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 9B is a multimodal foundation model from the Qwen 3.5 family, built for efficient reasoning, coding, and visual understanding in a compact 9B architecture.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 9B by Qwen (Alibaba) — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 9B operates in a hybrid thinking mode, toggling between quick responses and extended reasoning chains depending on task complexity. At 9 billion parameters it punches reasonably hard on multilingual tasks and code, with notably strong Chinese-English fluency.
